description: This file defines the DataEntityRow class, a Drupal Views plugin for rendering entity data as raw row data within the Drupal CMS. It manages entity type information, rendering, and querying functionalities.

classes.name: DataEntityRow
classes.description: A Drupal Views plugin class that displays entities as raw data rows, managing entity type, rendering, and querying.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DataEntityRow with necessary services and configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entity data for a given row, utilizing entity translation by relationship.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the base entity type ID for the view.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Provides access to the entity type manager service.

methods.name: getEntityRepository
methods.description: Provides access to the entity repository service.

methods.name: getLanguageManager
methods.description: Provides access to the language manager service.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes the query for the entity translation renderer, extending the parent query method.
